newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks close higher, lifted by surging Dow.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks close higher, lifted by surging Dow.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE

* Toronto stocks ended higher on Monday, extending last week's winning ways as Wall Street roared to a new record. * Inflation fears vanquished. * 80 million shares traded worth C$1.6 billion.
Toronto stocks closed higher on Monday, propelled by another surge on Wall Street as investors cast aside U.S. inflation and rate hike fears.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index gained 43.82 points to close to 6150.73. Trading was moderate at 80.1 million shares worth C$1.57 billion.

"The (U.S.) economy is growing at diminishing rates," said RBC Dominion Securities investment adviser Ira Katzin. "The feeling is now that (U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman) Alan Greenspan may not have to increase interest rates on May 20."
Fewer observers expect that Fed Reserve members would hike rates after last week's slew of data pointing to low inflation.

Investors and mutual fund managers built up cash piles as they sat out the six-week downturn in key North American equity markets, Katzin said. "Now, would you believe, they're all rushing through the same door at the same time?" he said.
In Toronto, all but three of the 14 sub-indices rose, led by consumer products, conglomerates and golds. The decliners were banks, base metals and media.
Advancing issues outnumbered declines 483 to 457, while 297 ended flat.
Last week, the 300 Index added almost five percent as inflation and rate hike fears waned.
--- HOT STOCKS ---

* Barrick Gold Corp jumped 0.85 to 32.25 in second most active trading. Bullion prices ticked upward since there was no longer the prospect of millions of ounces being added to world reserves, after the Bre-X Minerals Ltd gold find in Busang was declared a fraud.
* Small gold miners dropped as investors debated their worth. Indochina Goldfields Ltd fell 2.30 to 10.70.
((Lydia Zajc, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8109))
